title: Nebula RPG Glint Green
description: RPG Style, Changes the vanilla enchantment glint into a darker green nebula glint
body:
## Nebula Glint (Green)   ## Features ##### (Your vanilla experience will be further enhanced thanks to these features) ##### This changes your standard vanilla enchanted item and armor glint into a cool looking dark green nebula glint that looks really good in the dark! Change your Glint Strength in Accessibility settings to 100% for maximum effect.   Place inside your resourcepacks folder and enable in game from the resource pack menu.   ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/863/779/2024-05-10_02.png)     Get a server today and play with your friends!
